instruction: Fill in all absent city locations in the machine learning conference spreadsheet (2013–2019), and determine how many ICLR conferences appear.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires filling in all 21 conference city locations (rows 2-22, column C) from 2013-2019 for ICLR, ICML, and Neurips conferences, then counting ICLR entries. Verified with Python: ICLR appears 7 times (years 2013-2019). The evaluator checks if exactly 7 ICLR conferences have their cities filled.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: The evaluator correctly verifies BOTH instruction requirements: (1) All 21 conferences (rows 2-22) have cities filled, AND (2) ICLR conference count equals 7.

Getter logic is correct (getters/xlsx.py:36-47): Iterates through all rows 2-22, checks if ANY city is empty/blank (sets all_filled=False), and counts ICLR conferences separately. Returns {'all_filled': bool, 'iclr_count': int}.

Metric logic is correct (metrics/xlsx.py:19-30): Requires BOTH conditions to pass - all_filled must be True AND iclr_count must equal expected_count. Returns 1.0 only when both are satisfied, 0.0 otherwise.

Data flow is semantically correct: Getter extracts the right state (all cities filled status + ICLR count) -> Metric compares both aspects correctly -> Expected value (7 ICLR conferences) is accurate.
Edge case handling: The getter properly handles empty/blank city cells using 'not city_cell or (isinstance(city_cell, str) and not city_cell.strip())'.
Postconfig is appropriate: Activates the Calc window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) to ensure the getter reads the latest file state.
